# rpgjs-patches

> Narrow runtime repairs for CanvasEngine in RPGJS 5. Consumers inject Sprite and Viewport
> factories; installation returns a per-patch report. No runtime dependencies. Supports
> CanvasEngine >=2.2.0 <2.5.0, with upstream-fixed late sprite work skipped on 2.4.

## Documentation

- [Documentation site](https://jonbogaty.com/rpgjs-patches/): introduction, setup, and reference.
- [README](https://github.com/jbcom/rpgjs-patches/blob/main/README.md): installation and quick start.
- [API](https://github.com/jbcom/rpgjs-patches/blob/main/docs/API.md): exports and installation reports.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/jbcom/rpgjs-patches/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): runtime invariants.
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/jbcom/rpgjs-patches/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): real-release audit and retirement rules.
- [Decisions](https://github.com/jbcom/rpgjs-patches/blob/main/docs/decisions.md): audit and package choices.
- [Agent notes](https://github.com/jbcom/rpgjs-patches/blob/main/AGENTS.md): toolchain and editing constraints.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/jbcom/rpgjs-patches/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup and verification.
